exhibitions.summary: A recap of DEF Company’s fictional Vision Expo 2025 showcase, including the X1 Smart Camera demonstration and automated inspection applications.
exhibitions.body:
## A Record-Breaking Event

![Onsite at the exhibition](/images/event-3.jpg)

The Vision Expo 2025 in Stuttgart was a tremendous success for DEF Company. We welcomed over **500 industry professionals** to our booth to discuss the future of automated inspection.

## Showcasing the X1 Smart Camera

Our highlight of the event was the live demonstration of the new X1 Smart Camera. Visitors were impressed by its ability to process 10,000 frames per second.

## Key Highlights

- **Real-time Defect Detection:** Showcased flaw detection as small as 0.1 mm.
- **Seamless Integration:** Demonstrated plug-and-play compatibility with major PLC networks.
- **Predictive Analytics:** Introduced our new dashboard for predictive maintenance.

## What’s Next?

Missed us at the show? We will be attending Automate 2026 in Detroit this coming November. Stay tuned for more updates on our upcoming trade shows!
